items.title: CineBari app v1.4 is out — tap to download
items.text: The TV remote now works inside the app (channel zapping, channel list, number keys), downloads finish inside the app with the installer opening automatically, and there is a fresh new logo. Tap to download v1.4.

items.title: CineBari app v1.3.2 is out — tap to download
items.text: Fresh install for the latest fixes: Continue Watching now opens every movie, and the search icons are fixed. Tap to download v1.3.2.
CineBari v1.3.1 is live — clean install fix, and daily top-movie news notifications are now on. Tap to open CineBari.
items.title: CineBari v1.3.1 is live — tap to watch

items.text: New movies now appear first, a new Bangla Movies & Drama shelf is live, and a TV channel that stops working now switches automatically to the next working one.
items.title: CineBari updated — new movies first, Bangla drama, auto channel switching
